edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: C-section delivery changes early microbial colonization and immune education, which is the usual mechanistic explanation for later asthma links.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Si meta analysis in BMC Pediatr already points to caesarean birth tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
